reviewer: independent parkade_source_review agent; no participation in model construction
scope: Holistic visual model review of exact v005 GLB reimport evidence against current original metric CAD sources: envelope, topology, every elevation, openings, optics, parking/stair/ramp program, supports, contacts, cameras and three phone comparisons. Full regression, not a fix-only closure. CityPrompt integration and application readiness are outside this review.
source_authority: classic-cad-sources-v003 original design authority, with front/top governing coordinates and supplemental rear circulation section governing ramp topology. Archived AI studies remain aesthetic-only. Previous failed sources/candidates are not relabelled or approved by this result.

holistic_findings.finding: Low/wide native envelope, eight principal front bays, four parking levels including open roof, and two front glazed stair cores are compatible with the exact current metric design. This is a revised original-design variant, not a claim of exact fidelity to the superseded AI triptych.

Front, both sides, rear and rooftop are coherently constructed open parking architecture, with no blank secondary carriers, detached roof caps or obvious below-grade envelope. Ground contact is seated in whole views.

Transparent blue-grey clay reveals real stair flights, return flights, landings and handrails. Continuous slender-framed glass now wraps the core fronts and outer returns. The opaque return belts from v004 are absent; side beam ends terminate behind the core rather than through optical panes.

Recessed landings and bounded inner doorway bridges visibly join the main deck; the optical exterior is separately owned. Guard and frame ownership is legible. This does not certify accessible thresholds, emergency egress or runtime walk collision.

holistic_findings.category: rear ramp topology and load paths
holistic_findings.finding: Three same-direction parallel ramps link successive levels with end landings; the main decks exclude the continuous rear well. Sloped guards and edge girders follow ramp geometry; intermediate piers visibly continue to grade/frame outside the lane. No obvious alternating-ramp collision or unsupported detached horizontal guard remains.

Bays, aisles, arrows, open vehicle entrance, yellow entrance protection, readable entrance identity at inspection resolution, P signs, roof lights and separate stair access communicate a parkade. Interior structure and bay depth remain visible under neutral proof lighting.

Untextured semantic clay preserves distinct concrete, steel, glazing, marking, safety-yellow and sign roles. The glass reveals occupied depth and stairs rather than an empty shell or opaque image plane. Textured PBR fidelity is not claimed.

Every supplied full-resolution baseline/contact image and phone board was opened. Whole-building cameras retain visible margins; neutral interior lighting resolves earlier underexposure. Oblique comparison is on the corresponding corner. The schematic CAD axonometric remains a design diagram, with exact coordinates delegated to front/top as disclosed.

previous_blocker_closure.reason: Current metric CAD source authority explicitly resolves proportions and cadence prospectively; old failed model remains immutable.
Front and outer-return concrete belts removed; continuous optical core and recessed landings are visually proved.
Vehicle sign/entrance protection and pedestrian core are distinguishable in the current design.
Pitched edge girders and grounded intermediate supports are visibly present outside the intended lane.
Neutral interior proof, landing seam and ramp support close views plus matched phone boards provided.
Both side views and glass/stair close views show uninterrupted core returns with beam ends behind the core. Supporting six outer-return normal-ray checks pass against the exact successor GLB.

supporting_audit.interpretation: Supporting sparse exact-GLB surface rays, including return-glass clearance, stair/deck and ramp/landing contacts. These do not override pixels and do not certify complete collisions or engineering adequacy.

nonblocking_polish: Whole-building and phone views necessarily reduce small entrance text readability; retain close previews for detailed inspection.
CAD axonometric is schematic and its fill order is imperfect; front/top/section are explicit metric authorities. It is not a substitute for the complete GLB reimport evidence.
remaining_limitations: Architectural-clay model review only. No textured keeper status, structural engineering, building-code, accessibility, fire/egress or vehicle swept-path certification.
Four authored levels at native fixed dimensions; no arbitrary stretching, alternate floor counts or repeatable-floor metadata approved.
No moving doors, animated vehicles, traffic simulation or operational parking-control functionality reviewed or promised.

CityPrompt catalogue, actual app renderer/placement/grounding, selection/move/rotate/delete, undo/redo, save/reload, deterministic AI capture and student laptop/mobile performance remain untested by this reviewer.
Human runtime activation, publication, asset-storage and production deployment gates remain separate. This review does not authorize push or deployment.
Any later evidence of a defect reopens this exact-byte review; preserve the reviewed package and failed predecessor lineage.
